rows.text: You walk into the most adorable Kiliro Fish Restaurant on Pier Point — a place made of a giant bubble in the shape of a fish eye. Through the curved glass, you can see the subspace barrier. You have a good time in the pleasant afternoon sunshine.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: While the other customers are enjoying the piscatorial ultrasonic wave cerebral fascia massage, you stuff a fish eye into your mouth and plunge into a social dreamland. Pier Point is seeing a period of development during which the galactic currency will be raining down regularly from the sky. You are thrilled, as you own the IPC's bonds.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your mind returns to reality when the fish eye is fully digested in your stomach. It's time for you to go to work, but you are reluctant to move...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Never go to work again! Never...
Obtain 1 Nihility Blessing of 2- to 3-star rarity.
Swallow the other fish eye and continue to enjoy the massage.
